With a growing online presence, Jouri Hijab makes its products easily accessible to customers worldwide, providing a seamless shopping experience.

stores.name: Bianca.Nera

stores.description: Emirates NBD is a leading Middle Eastern financial services group and bank headquartered in the UAE, offering retail, corporate, investment, and digital banking solutions across multiple countries including Saudi Arabia. stores.name: Fayendra
stores.description: Fayendra is a jewelry brand offering a wide range of elegant and refined silver and gemstone jewelry for men and women, blending classic artistry with modern design. The brand’s collections include rings, bracelets, necklaces, earrings, and luxury accessories, designed to celebrate life’s special moments with timeless elegance and craftsmanship. Their products are showcased through numerous showrooms across Saudi Arabia and the UAE

Starting from a modest shop near the Holy Mosque in Makkah, the brand expanded to Jeddah and across the Gulf, blending Arabic fragrance heritage with contemporary craftsmanship to create oud, amber, musk, and bespoke perfume blends that celebrate luxury and authenticity. Today, Ibraq is considered one of the leading perfume brands in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf region.

stores.name: Ateej

He then comes up with a different plan: instead of stealing money, each member of the family secretly secures a job inside the home of an extremely wealthy family, without anyone knowing they are related.
